newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DUNDEE VOTED PLAYERS' PLAYER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUNDEE VOTED PLAYERS' PLAYER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Karlsruhe striker Sean Dundee has been voted Germany's player of the year by his fellow professionals, organisers of the new award said on Wednesday.
The 23-year old South African, who hopes to become a German citizen soon, beat VfB Stuttgart striker Giovane Elber and his Karlsruhe team mate Thomas Haessler to the accolade.
"It's the first time I've won an award like this," said Dundee, the Bundesliga's leading scorer this season. "I feel very honoured."

Dundee is the first winner of the new award, organised by the Professional Footballers' Association (VdV). The traditional player of the year award is decided by a poll of sports journalists later in the year.

Dundee's rise to success in the Bundesliga has been meteoric. He began last season officially classed as an amateur with Karlsruhe but quickly forced his way into the first team and scored 16 league goals.

That tally put him joint second in the Bundesliga goalscorers' table, alongside such seasoned marksmen as Bayern Munich's Juergen Klinsmann. He has continued his good form this season, netting 12 times in the league.
Dundee has applied for German citizenship using a special fast-track process for cases of "public interest" and hopes to play for the German national side as soon as possible.
